note: Image-verified adjudications applied on top of the OCR archive (and the _waqf_*.json old corpus) by scripts/build-waqf-calibration.ts and scripts/analyze-waqf-archive.ts. excludedDates drop the archive date entirely (the poster itself is misprinted or absent); excludedCells drop single cells the Waqf misprinted (no trustworthy printed value exists); corrections replace archive cells, oldCorpusCorrections replace _waqf transcription cells, with the value read from the poster at native/zoomed resolution.
